note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records, not by website claims: real outbound shipments from Nhava Sheva, Cochin, Jaigarh and Mumbai customs houses to Singapore, Kenya (Mombasa), Marshall Islands and Novorossiysk, Jan-Feb 2026. Nature of cargo is ship-store supply of Mobil-branded marine lubricants (Mobilgard, Mobil Rarus, Mobil DTE, Mobil EAL Arctic) to vessel masters — i.e. the company acts as a supplier/trader of finished lubricants to ships, not as a refinery. Declared HS 271019 is broadly consistent with the observed lubricating-oil codes 27101979/27101989, though one row is 34039900 (lubricant preparations) — HS is a mixed basket, no correction needed beyond noting the 34039900 line. Role: trader/distributor (ship chandler), not manufacturer. Domestic supply evidence: NOT verified — the DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned connection errors on all three attempts, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits could not be retrieved; recorded as null rather than guessed. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free view — null. Second slug variant /mars-petrochem-pvt-ltd returned an empty record set (no shipments shown), so the confirmed data rests on the first slug only. No rejection grounds: entity is active and shipping.
